description: The signed-in couple's own guest list on Zola: add a full guest list from a sheet, a CSV or an Excel file that the couple gives. Send the rows as CSV text, with the header row. Zola reads the names, households, addresses, emails and phones as its import page does. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview of the households with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple, with the households that match a guest of the guest list and stay out. Call again with the same csv and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. The import only adds households: it changes no guest that is on the list. To change a household that is on the list, use zola_update_my_guest. A wedding can import 1 list each hour and 3 each day. Status: preview (nothing changed yet), nothing_to_import, incomplete (Zola could not read a part of the list), done (added). A call with a used confirm_token returns the stored result. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

add_matching_households.description: True adds also the households with a guest that the guest list already has. Leave it out to leave them out. Set it only after the couple saw the matches and said to add them

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same csv and add_matching_households

csv.description: The full guest list as CSV text: a header row, then 1 row for each household or guest. Copy the rows of the couple's sheet or file as they are, with the columns that it has (names, address, email, phone). Do not change, add or remove a row

name: zola_import_my_guest_list

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of a guest list import of the signed-in couple

add_household_count.description: The households that the confirm adds, or that it added

changed.description: True only when this call added households to the guest list

confirm_token.description: Give it to zola_import_my_guest_list with the same csv and add_matching_households, only after the couple says yes

expires_at.description: The end of the validity of confirm_token, ISO 8601 UTC

household_count.description: The households that Zola found in the list

households.description: The households in the order of the list. No address, email or phone

add.description: True when the confirm adds the household

matches.description: The guests of the guest list that match a guest of this household

guest_group_id.description: The household on the guest list, as zola_search_my_guests gives it

name.description: The guests of the household, as the list names them

left_out_households.description: Households of the preview that matched a guest at the confirm, and that Zola did not add

matched_household_count.description: The households with a guest that the guest list already has

merged.description: The rows that Zola merged into 1 household

notes.description: Notes about the households, with no contact value

kind.description: phone_not_read: the household gets no phone. adults_as_children: Zola adds the adults after the second as children. child_without_first_name: Zola does not add that child

replayed.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same confirm_token

status.description: preview: nothing changed, confirm_token adds the households with add true. nothing_to_import: no household to add. incomplete: Zola could not read a part of the list, nothing changed. done: added. draft_changed: a household got a new match after the preview, nothing changed: a new preview with a new confirm_token

unreadable_parts.description: The parts of the list that Zola could not read

title: Import My Guest List
